skills.name: broker-operations
skills.description: Operating a Coreflux broker over MQTT: the $SYS/Coreflux/Command payload and the Command/Output reply envelope, the $SYS/Coreflux topic map, route status and action trace JSON, a triage playbook, users, groups and permission flags, env vs secrets, and projects and .lotnb notebooks.

skills.name: broker-tools
skills.description: Complete reference for the tools you can call on a Coreflux broker: the MCP tool surface the Hub assistant and MCP clients use (validate_lot, deploy_lot, explore_topics, diagnose, provision_data_source and one tool per registry command), the broker__ tools a DEFINE AGENT is granted (read_mqtt, write_mqtt, read_lot, create_lot, execute_routes, execute_actions), Insight vs Agent mode, and the mandatory workflow for deploying LoT safely.

skills.name: lot-actions
skills.description: How to write LOT actions: triggers, variables, topic operations, control flow, callable actions, and integrations (Python, MCP, LLM).

skills.name: lot-agents
skills.description: How to write a DEFINE AGENT: the TYPE LLM connector it uses, required clauses, ADD TOOL grants scoped to topics or targets, delegation peers, CALL AGENT from actions, and how agents are added, updated and removed.

skills.name: lot-models
skills.description: How to write LOT models: data schemas, field types, MQTT topic bindings, triggers, behaviors (Default, Keep, Collapsed), storage, and inheritance.

skills.name: lot-panels
skills.description: How to write LoTV panel definitions: DEFINE PANEL, ADD COMPONENT, BIND, ON events, WITH VISIBILITY, WITH INTERACT, and the mandatory workflow for deploying panels via broker.add_panel.

skills.name: lot-routes
skills.description: How to write LOT connectors: database, OT (Modbus, S7, OPC UA, EtherNet/IP, ADS, Allen-Bradley, Fins), REST API, AI (LLM, MCP), MQTT bridge/cluster, Kafka/REST integrations, email, barcode, video, events, mappings, and OT TAG blocks.

skills.name: lot-rules
skills.description: How to write LOT permission rules: ALLOW/DENY, topic patterns, user/group conditions, priority-based evaluation, and operation scopes.

skills.name: lot-themes
skills.description: How to write LoTV theme definitions: DEFINE THEME with design tokens (colors, typography, spacing), EXTENDS inheritance, WHEN MODE light/dark, DEFINE THEME_VARIANT for component overrides, and deployment via broker.add_theme.

skills.name: lot-things
skills.description: How DEFINE THING works: templates and roots, WITH clauses, {{param}} placeholders, references, expanded child names, and why a Thing-owned child must be changed through its Thing.

skills.name: python-scripts
skills.description: How to write and manage Python scripts: naming conventions, function structure, add/remove scripts, CALL PYTHON from LOT, available modules.
